message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"The most likely cause of checkout request failures is the exhaustion of the ledger-service database connection pool, which was reduced from 64 to 8 connections in a recent deployment, leading to timeouts and service unavailability.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:3","log:4","log:7","log:5","log:6","log:8","log:9"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"A deployment of ledger-service at 09:02 reduced the database pool max size from 64 to 8 connections.","evidence_ids":["log:1"]},{"claim":"At 09:18, ledger-service logged warnings about db pool wait times exceeding thresholds with all 8 connections in use and 31 queued requests.","evidence_ids":["log:3"]},{"claim":"At 09:19 and 09:24, ledger-service logged errors about connection pool exhaustion and timeouts acquiring connections after 5000ms with max=8.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:7"]},{"claim":"At 09:20, checkout-api logged an error indicating ledger-service call failed with upstream 503 after 5012ms.","evidence_ids":["log:5"]},{"claim":"At 09:21, checkout-api logged order submission failures due to ledger-service being unavailable.","evidence_ids":["log:6"]},{"claim":"At 09:30, checkout-api logged a circuit breaker opening for ledger-service after 47 consecutive failures.","evidence_ids":["log:8"]},{"claim":"At 09:41, ledger-service still had maxed out db pool connections with 38 queued requests.","evidence_ids":["log:9"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check the ledger-service database connection pool configuration and usage metrics.","Review recent deployment changes affecting ledger-service connection pool size.","Monitor checkout-api circuit breaker status and failure rates for ledger-service calls."]}
